high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of a social media post from the account "cosmosrevealed." The post is about a man who died in West Africa due to the Marburg virus, which causes internal bleeding and organ failure. The World Health Organization (WHO) has warned that the disease has the potential to spread far and wide. The post includes the following details: A man in Guinea, West Africa, has died of the Marburg virus. The WHO stated that the disease can be passed to humans from fruit bats. The post also encourages engagement by asking users to like, share, and join the community for more knowledge.
